query: These PNGs in ./assets are too large - compress them for web.
expected_behavior: Resolves ./assets as the target set of images to optimize
Delegates the run to the optimize-images-runner subagent via the Task tool rather than running pngquant, cwebp, or jpegoptim directly in the main session
Stays orchestration-only (haiku tier): resolves the target, hands off, and relays - it does not inline the tool run or add compression judgment the runner owns
Relays the runner's per-file savings report (or a clean tool-not-installed message with the install hint) rather than re-doing the work
